planSteps.description: Navigate to / and scroll through the landing page.
The "How it works" section shows the three step titles "Describe or upload", "AI generates the layout", and "Drag, rotate, refine".
The "Features" section shows cards titled "Pixel-perfect to scale", "Collision detection", "One-click rotate", "Any room, any furniture", and "Shopping suggestions".
The "The loop" section shows the four verification loop labels "Write", "Verify", "Fix", and "Verify again".
